summary: Iteration 13 - Comprehensive testing of new notification, quick demand, and map features. All 14 backend tests passed. All frontend E2E tests passed. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/messages/unread-summary returns demands with unread messages correctly for both customers and suppliers, 2) POST /api/demands/quick creates quick demands without authentication, 3) POST /api/demands/claim claims quick demands after login, 4) Supplier can send messages and soft-accept quick demands (triggers notification), 5) Customer dashboard shows unread badges on stat cards, notification banner with demand links, and map with colored markers, 6) Supplier dashboard shows tab sections with unread badges, 7) Registration page pre-fills email from claim_demand URL parameter.

minor.issue: FRONTEND_URL was concatenated with SMTP_FROM_NAME on same line - FIXED

issues: Overview map only shows when demands have coordinates - currently no available demands with coordinates visible

seed_data_creation: Multiple quick demands created during testing with unique IDs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Unread messages summary endpoint works for both customer and supplier roles, returns demand_id, demand_title, demand_status, last_sender, last_message, last_message_at. 2) Quick demand flow: POST /api/demands/quick creates demand with is_quick=True, stores customer_email/phone for notifications. 3) Claim flow: POST /api/demands/claim updates customer_id for matching email. 4) Notification flow: When supplier sends message or soft-accepts quick demand, notify_quick_demand_supplier_reply is called with registration link. 5) Customer dashboard: stat cards show unread badges (red circles), notification banner shows unread demands with links, map shows demands with colored markers (green=open, orange=in_progress, grey=completed). 6) Supplier dashboard: tabs show unread badges, overview map shows all demands with colored markers (green=available, red=in_progress, grey=completed, orange=cancelled). 7) Registration page: claim_demand and email URL params are handled correctly.

UNREAD_MESSAGES_SUMMARY_ENDPOINT.details: GET /api/messages/unread-summary returns correct structure for both customer and supplier

QUICK_DEMAND_CREATION.details: POST /api/demands/quick works without auth, validates required fields, creates demand with is_quick flag

QUICK_DEMAND_CLAIM.details: POST /api/demands/claim requires auth, updates customer_id for matching email

SUPPLIER_REPLY_TO_QUICK_DEMAND.details: Supplier can soft-accept and send messages to quick demands, triggers notification

CUSTOMER_DASHBOARD_UNREAD_BADGES.details: Stat cards show red badge with unread count

CUSTOMER_DASHBOARD_NOTIFICATION_BANNER.details: Orange banner shows unread demands with links to demand detail

CUSTOMER_DASHBOARD_MAP.details: Map shows demands with colored markers, legend shows status colors

SUPPLIER_DASHBOARD_TAB_BADGES.details: Tab headers can show unread badges (tested structure, no unread messages for test supplier)

SUPPLIER_DASHBOARD_OVERVIEW_MAP.details: Overview map component exists, shows when demands have coordinates

REGISTRATION_CLAIM_DEMAND_PARAM.details: Registration page pre-fills email from URL parameter, shows claim info

HOMEPAGE_QUICK_DEMAND_MODAL.details: Modal opens, all form fields present, submission works, success message shown
